text.text_excerpt: I tried City Greens at Wednesday at the Square and loved the salad. I've never been able to make it to the Poydras site and was super excited to hear that they were opening a new location right across the street from my work! I've been here multiple times at lunch and once during dinner and have had a few different items (Southwest salad, no onions add chicken; Quinoa, Kale and Corn salad, add chicken; Shaved Raw Market salad, no onions add chicken; Thai peanut chicken salad and as a wrap.) I've found the salad to be reasonably priced when I do not add chicken (an extra $3) to the salad. I tried this place out because I've been trying to eat better and I didn't have time to make lunch this particular day. The salad I got was delicious, the guy who took my order was very helpful when realizing that I was a new customer. However, the prices are a bit steep. If you like a lot of toppings in your salad, you could be spending a lot of money here. However, they provide farm fresh ingredients so you'll get what you pay for. I would definitely come here again but it's not a place that I see myself visiting several days out of the week.

When I moved back to New Orleans after 2 years of being away, I swore to myself that I would eat healthier than I did during undergrad. Working on Airline means working amongst a sea of fast food places. Yuck. Anyways, City Greens combines fresh, healthy, and local to create some pretty amazing salads. They grow all their own lettuce, and seem to really take care of the details; for example, the tomatoes are marinated. One of my favorite salads is romaine, diced egg, tomatoes, red onions, blue cheese, and steak, tossed in their roasted tomato vinagrette. Yum.
